trigger_condition: Interrupted thought rendered on a shared/read-only conversation page
potential_consequence: Anonymous shared-page viewer can Allow/Deny another user's pending tool call

trigger_condition: User has enabled 'Hide tool outputs' in ChatConfiguration (persisted via chatStorageUtils)
potential_consequence: hideToolOutputs setting becomes a dead no-op toggle; tool thoughts always render regardless of user preference

trigger_condition: resumeToolCall called while chat.history is empty or last group is empty
potential_consequence: TypeError reading .length/index of undefined crashes the click handler

trigger_condition: Allow/Deny clicked on an older message or after the pending thought was already resolved
guard_snippet: if (!lastInterrupted) return; // nothing pending, do not send resume
potential_consequence: Sends a tool-call resume request and flips inProgress even though no call is actually pending, resolving the wrong/no call

trigger_condition: assistantIds changes again before the previous Promise.all(getAssistant) resolves
potential_consequence: Stale assistant fetch overwrites newer state, showing wrong policy/allowOverride for the current conversation

trigger_condition: getAssistant fails for one or all attached assistants
guard_snippet: on fetch failure keep previous/ASK_FOR_APPROVAL instead of defaulting to AUTO_APPROVE
potential_consequence: Silently fails open to the least-restrictive auto-approve policy instead of failing closed
Field name mismatch (camelCase vs snake_case) means backend never receives the field; user's policy override silently fails to persist

trigger_condition: Saving an assistant form after the tool_call_policy/allow_override Yup fields are added
guard_snippet: delete preparedValues.tool_call_policy; delete preparedValues.allow_override; before spreading into payload
potential_consequence: Duplicate top-level tool_call_policy/allow_override fields sent alongside the nested tool_permissions object, polluting the assistant save payload

trigger_condition: Assistant is non-CODEMIE type or TOOL_PERMISSIONS feature flag is disabled (UI hidden)
potential_consequence: Default tool_permissions payload is still sent to the backend even though the corresponding UI was never shown to the user

trigger_condition: value does not match any ToolCallPolicy option (legacy/malformed backend value)
potential_consequence: Dropdown renders blank with no label/icon instead of a sensible fallback

trigger_condition: resumeToolCall's stream request fails (network error, 5xx, aborted)
guard_snippet: in finishThoughts/markThoughtDone also clear thought.interrupted on failure, or add explicit catch in resumeToolCall
potential_consequence: thought.interrupted never clears on failure; isToolCallPending stays true forever, permanently disabling the prompt box until a retry happens to succeed

trigger_condition: currentChat.toolCallPolicy holds a value outside the ToolCallPolicy enum (backend drift, migration, legacy require_confirmation boolean)
potential_consequence: Unvalidated cast feeds an invalid value into the dropdown, triggering the blank-selection gap above
